rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: Kizuna is a free collecting game. These rules keep it fair and friendly for everyone.

account.title: One account per person
account.body: Play with a single account. Extra accounts made to farm free boosters, invite rewards or market deals will be removed, along with everything they earned.

bots.title: No bots or exploits
bots.body: Don't automate the game, script requests or take advantage of bugs. If you find a bug, report it instead of using it.

market.title: Trade fairly
market.body: Market sales pay a 5% fee. Sales and accepted trades are final, so check what you give before you confirm. Don't use the market to move cards or currency between accounts you control.

chat.title: Be kind in chat
chat.body: No harassment, hate speech, spam, scams or personal information, yours or anyone else's. Admins can delete messages.

names.title: Usernames and profiles
names.body: Pick a username that isn't offensive and doesn't impersonate someone else. The same goes for your showcase and messages.

money.title: No real-money trading
money.body: Cards, boosters, currency and accounts can't be bought or sold for real money, inside or outside the game.

enforcement.title: If the rules are broken
enforcement.body: Depending on how serious it is, admins can delete messages, take back items gained unfairly or suspend the account.

rarities.title: Rarities
rarities.intro: Every character has one rarity, set by how popular they are on AniList: the most loved characters are the rarest.
rarities.tableNote: Chance per card is for a slot that allows any rarity. Chance per booster is the chance of at least one card of that rarity in a standard 5-card booster, without golden, divine or guarantee bonuses.

slots.title: How a booster is filled
slots.body: A standard booster has 5 cards. The first three can be any rarity, the fourth is Uncommon or better and the fifth Rare or better. Each slot rolls with the chances above, limited to the rarities it allows.

golden.title: Golden boosters
golden.body: Every 10th standard booster is golden: its last card is Epic or better. Day 7 of the login streak also makes your next booster golden.

pity.title: Mythic guarantee
pity.body: If 249 standard boosters in a row have no Mythic, the 250th has one for sure. The counter starts again whenever you pull a Mythic.

divine.title: Divine boosters
divine.body: Any booster has a 1 in 2,000 chance to be divine: every card is Epic or better and the last one is a Mythic.

daily.title: The daily pack
daily.body: Once a day you can open a free themed pack whose last card is Epic or better.

recycle.title: Recycling duplicates
recycle.body: Duplicates can be recycled for currency at the values in the table. One copy of every card is always kept.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: By playing Kizuna you agree to these terms. They are written in plain language; if something is unclear, ask us.

service.title: What Kizuna is
service.body: Kizuna is an unofficial, non-commercial fan project. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by the creators, studios or publishers of the series it shows. Character names and images come from AniList and belong to their owners.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You sign in with Discord and must be old enough to use Discord where you live. You're responsible for what happens on your account, so keep your Discord account secure.

virtual.title: Virtual items
virtual.body: Cards, boosters and currency are virtual items with no real-world value. They can't be exchanged for money, and we may rebalance, change or reset them as the game evolves.

conduct.title: Playing fair
conduct.body: You agree to follow the game rules. We can remove content, take back items obtained unfairly or suspend accounts that break them.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: The game is provided as is, without any guarantee that it will always be available or free of bugs. We may change or stop it at any time.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: As far as the law allows, we aren't liable for lost items or data, or for any indirect damage that comes from using the game.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms. The date at the top shows the current version, and playing after a change means you accept it.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains what Kizuna stores about you and why. We keep only what the game needs.

collect.title: What we store
collect.body: The details Discord shares when you sign in (account ID, Discord name and email address); the username and avatar you pick in Kizuna; your game data such as your collection, boosters opened, missions, wishlist and showcase; your market activity, trades, friends, chat and direct messages; and who invited you or whom you invited.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: Only to run the game: signing you in, saving your progress, showing your profile and running the market, chat and friends. We don't sell your data, show ads or use tracking or analytics tools.

public.title: What other players see
public.body: Your username, avatar, showcase, wishlist, collection stats and big pulls are visible to other players, as are your chat messages in public rooms and your market listings. Direct messages are only visible to you and the person you write to.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: We use a cookie to keep you signed in, one to remember your language and one to remember an invite link. Your sound, animation and chat-room settings are stored in your browser.

providers.title: Services we rely on
providers.body: The game is hosted on Vercel and its database and sign-in run on Supabase. Discord handles the login, and character images load from AniList.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You can ask for a copy of your data or for your account and its data to be deleted. Ask an admin in the game chat and we'll take care of it.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update this page. The date at the top shows the current version.

install.body: Add Kizuna to your home screen: its own icon, full screen, one tap away.
install.manual: To install it, open your browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

rules.title: How to play
rules.step1: You draw 10 cards for the whole match and may swap up to 2 before it starts.
rules.step2: Players take turns: play one card, or pass. Once you pass, you're out until the next round.
rules.step3: When both players have passed, the higher total wins the round.
rules.step4: Lose two rounds and you lose the duel (a drawn round costs both players a life).
rules.step5: Cards on the board are cleared after each round, and you don't draw new ones: winning a round with few cards is the real skill.
rules.step6: The loser of a round starts the next one.
rules.rowsText: Each card belongs to one row (shown on the card). Weather and horns affect a whole row.
rules.hero: Mythic cards are heroes: nothing changes their strength and Burn can't destroy them.
rules.bond: Each unit gets +1 for every other unit of the same series on your side, so series sets get stronger together.
rules.deck: 22 to 25 of your own cards, with at most 1 Mythic, 2 Legendary and 4 Epic, plus up to 6 tactics (2 of a kind).

twentyOne.name: Kizuna 21
twentyOne.pitch: Blackjack against the house, nothing staked: each card is worth what its rarity says.

rules.goal: Get as close to 21 as you can without going over, and beat the house. Hit takes a card, Stand lets the house play.
rules.values: A card is worth what its rarity says: Common 2 to 4, Uncommon 5 or 6, Rare 7 or 8, Epic 9, Legendary 10, Mythic 11 or 1.
rules.house: The house draws until it has 17 or more. A 21 with your first two cards beats a 21 made with three cards or more, for you and for the house alike.
rules.points: A hand won scores 10 points, a 21 with your first two cards 15, a tie 5, a hand lost 0. Nothing is staked and your score never goes down. A game is 10 hands.

Pick the anime among the four: the sooner you answer, the more you score (up to 100 points). A wrong answer scores nothing. A game is 10 series, among the best known.

fusion.hint: Swipe or use the arrow keys
fusion.share: I scored {score} at Fusion on Kizuna, up to {rarity}!
fusion.rules: The board is 4 by 4. Swipe or press the arrow keys (or WASD) to slide every card. Two cards of the same tier that meet fuse into the next tier, and each card fuses once a move. There are 12 tiers: each rarity has a normal and an awakened card, from common to mythic awakened. After every move a new common or uncommon card appears. You score the value of each card a fusion makes (4, 8, 16 ... up to 4096). The game ends when nothing can move. 3 stars at 15,000 points, 2 at 6,000, 1 at 2,000.

memory.name: Memory
memory.pitch: Find the {n} pairs of cards in as few moves as you can.
memory.share: I found {pairs} pairs in {moves} moves at Memory on Kizuna!
memory.rules: Flip two cards each move. Same character: the pair stays up; otherwise both flip back. Three levels: 8, 12 or 18 pairs. Find every pair in as few moves as you can: 3 stars up to 1.5 moves a pair, 2 up to 2, 1 up to 2.75.

poker.hint: Pick the cards that go together: same series, same genre (the seal at the bottom) or rarities in a row. Then Play.
poker.sameSeries: cards of this series in your hand
poker.formula: A hand scores (chips + card power ÷ 10) × multiplier; only the cards that make the hand count.

rules.goal: Make groups of cards that go together, like in poker. You have 4 hands to score as much as you can, and 3 discards to swap the cards you don't want (up to 5 at a time).
rules.series: Same series: 2 cards make a pair, 3 three of a kind, 4 four of a kind, 5 five of a series.
rules.genre: Same genre: the seal at the bottom of the card. 5 cards of the same genre make a flush.
rules.straight: Letters in a row: the rarity letter at the top right. C U R E L (a Mythic counts as L) make a straight; with the same genre, a straight flush.

handText.straight_flush: rarities in a row, same genre
handText.straight: 5 rarities in a row (C U R E L)

dailyHand.name: Daily hand
dailyHand.pitch: The same hand for everyone, a new one every day at midnight (Paris). Your first score of the day counts in the ranking.
dailyHand.comeBack: A new hand at midnight (Paris). Meanwhile, practise with Kizuna Hand.
dailyHand.share: I scored {score} on today's Daily hand on Kizuna!

kizunaHand.name: Kizuna Hand
kizunaHand.pitch: Card poker: combine series, genres and rarities on a random hand, as often as you like, with help if you need it.

raid.comeBack: A new raid at midnight (Paris). Meanwhile, practise with Kizuna Raid.

heal.name: Heal
heal.text: Standing cards get half their health back.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.text: +20% health for the whole team (a little less each time you take it again).

training.name: Training
training.text: +15% attack for the whole team (a little less each time you take it again).

shield.name: Shield
shield.text: Every wave, each card blocks the first blow it takes, up to half its health.

precision.name: Precision
precision.text: +10% critical chance, and critical hits hurt more.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.text: Each blow heals the striker by 8% of its damage.

reinforcements.name: Reinforcements
reinforcements.text: Fallen cards come back with half their health.

focus.name: {genre} focus
focus.text: +40% attack for the team's {genre} cards (a little less each time you take it again).

evo_bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
evo_bloodlust.text: Vampire + Precision: every critical hit heals the whole team.

evo_fortress.name: Fortress
evo_fortress.text: Shield + Stamina: every knock-out recharges the whole team's shield.

evo_frenzy.name: Frenzy
evo_frenzy.text: Adrenaline + Training: every knock-out speeds the team up until the end of the wave.

dragon_heart.name: Dragon heart
dragon_heart.text: +40% health and the whole team comes back to full, fallen cards too.

hourglass.name: Hourglass
hourglass.text: For the first 5 seconds of each wave, the team attacks twice as fast.

totem.name: Totem
totem.text: Every wave, the first card to fall gets up with 40% health.

raid.areaWarn: The boss is gathering a strike!

rules.auto: Auto battle: your team strikes the enemies on its own, wave after wave. A wave lost ends the raid.
rules.bonus: After each wave, pick one bonus out of three, common to epic: heal, reinforcements, shield, vampire…
rules.boss: A boss every 5 waves: one very tough card with two minions and a trait (Enraged, Regeneration or Thorns). It gathers an area strike every 9 seconds; the warning shows just before.
rules.stats: Attack and health by rarity: C 10/70, U 13/85, R 17/100, E 23/120, L 31/150, M 42/190. A card's power adds up to 33%.
rules.series: Same anime: 2 cards +40% attack for them, 3 cards +80%.
rules.genres: Genres (2 cards / 3 or more): Battle crits +12/24% · Fantasy hits the next one 35/70% · Romance heals 4/8% per blow · Slice of life health +25/50% · Thrills double strike 12/24% · Sci-fi & Sport attacks 20/40% faster.
rules.stars: Cards evolve: a star at 3, 8 and 15 knock-outs, +25% attack and health each (a boss counts as 5).
rules.powers: Legendary and Mythic powers: Blade storm, Meteor, Healing wave, Rampart, Terror, Overdrive. A Legendary uses it every 11 seconds, a Mythic every 8 and 50% stronger.
rules.elites: Elite enemies: Armoured (takes 40% less), Fast, Healer, Explosive (blows up on your team when it falls).
rules.relics: After each boss, pick a relic out of three: powerful bonuses found nowhere else.
rules.score: Your score is the number of waves cleared. Stars at waves 3, 6 and 10.

dailyRaid.name: Daily raid
dailyRaid.pitch: The same 8 cards and the same waves for everyone, every day. Your first raid of the day counts in the ranking.
dailyRaid.share: I cleared {n} waves in today's Daily raid on Kizuna!

kizunaRaid.name: Kizuna Raid
kizunaRaid.pitch: Build a team of 5 cards and watch it fight waves of enemies on its own.
kizunaRaid.share: I cleared {n} waves in Kizuna Raid!

connections.name: Connections
connections.pitch: Sixteen cards hide four groups of four. Find what links them before you run out of tries.
connections.rules: Sixteen cards hide four groups of four: the same series, the same genre (the seal at the bottom), the same rarity (the letter at the top), or the same theme (shonen, seinen, shojo, isekai, sports, mecha). Pick four cards and submit. Some cards seem to belong to two groups: only one way solves the board. Four mistakes and the game is over. 100 points a group, 25 off a mistake.
connections.comeBack: A new board at midnight (Paris). Meanwhile, play Connections as much as you like.
connections.share: I solved Connections on Kizuna with {mistakes} mistakes!

dailyConnections.name: Daily connections
dailyConnections.pitch: The same sixteen cards for everyone, a new board every day. Your first try of the day counts in the ranking.
dailyConnections.share: I solved today's Connections on Kizuna with {mistakes} mistakes!

expedition.name: The Expedition
expedition.pitch: Buy a team of 5 cards on a budget, then travel chapter after chapter: fights, treasures, shops and bosses. Your cards gain ranks that stay.
expedition.share: My expedition on Kizuna went {n} cases deep!
expedition.search: Search a card or a series
expedition.comeBack: Your team rests: five fights a day. Come back tomorrow (Paris midnight).
expedition.won: Case cleared! +{shards} shards · +{xp} XP to the team · +{tickets} tickets
expedition.lost: Your team fell. The expedition is over.

potion.name: Potion
potion.text: Heals the team by 50% of their health.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.text: Brings fallen cards back at half health.

potion.name: Potion
potion.text: Goes in your bag: heals 50% when you need it.

tonic.name: Tonic
tonic.text: Goes in your bag: +15% attack for one case.

adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
adrenaline.text: Faster attacks until the chapter ends.

rules.team: Build a team of 5 different cards from the whole catalogue with a budget of 20: Common 1, Uncommon 2, Rare 3, Epic 5, Legendary 8, Mythic 12.
rules.route: Each chapter has 10 cases: fight, treasure, fight, shop, boss, fight, treasure, fight, shop, boss. The map shows the cases behind you, the next one and the bosses; the rest stays in the fog. Each chapter follows a series: its cards are most of the enemies, and your cards from it hit 20% harder.
rules.fights: A fight is 3 waves, the boss waits in the last wave of a boss case. Your team fights on its own, like in raids. Health carries over from wave to wave and case to case: lose a case and the expedition ends.
rules.rewards: A won fight gives 30 shards, 22 XP to each card of the team, tickets (6, then one more each chapter, up to 10) and a bonus to pick. Bonuses last until the chapter ends; beating its last boss heals the team.
rules.shop: Treasures give 40 shards, 3 tickets and a bag item (Potion, Tonic or Phoenix). Shops sell three offers for shards. Between cases you can use bag items and swap one card (budget still 20; the newcomer takes over its health).
rules.ranks: Cards keep their experience between expeditions: rank 1 at 30 XP, 2 at 90, 3 at 200, 4 at 400, 5 at 700. Each rank adds 12% attack and health.
rules.daily: Five fights a day (bosses included); treasures and shops don't count. The expedition waits for you across days.
rules.score: Your score is the number of cases cleared; the weekly ranking keeps your furthest expedition.

expedition.bonusKept: One only, kept until the end of the chapter.

blindTest.name: Blind test

pitches.easy: Openings of the big classics. Listen to 30 seconds and find the series among four.
pitches.medium: Openings and endings of well-known series. Listen to 30 seconds and find the series among four.
pitches.hard: The whole bank of themes. Listen to 30 seconds and find the series among four.

blindTest.rules: 10 theme clips of 30 seconds. Find the series among four answers: the faster you are, the more points (up to 100). A wrong answer gives 0. After each answer you see the song, the artist and a character of the series.
blindTest.share: I scored {score} at the Kizuna blind test!

table.title: Play with others
table.pitch: Up to {n} players get the same questions. The fastest right answers win.
table.matchText: Sit at a table waiting for players, or open one.
table.openText: Get a code to share; you start when everyone is here.
table.share: Share this code with your friends (Discord, messages…).
table.waitHost: Waiting for the host to start…
table.waitOthers: Waiting for the others to answer…
